label: 通常プレイ・ボクセル要素追加
intent: Subtle selective voxel accents on office props and particles; rounded cartoon characters and existing screen state.
purpose: Generated screen mockup for art-direction planning; not implemented gameplay.
prompt:
Edit the attached exact Japanese videogame screen mockup for 「全力退勤」 with a SUBTLE, selective amount of 3D VOXEL ART. Treat this as a small focused art-direction revision: about 85% of the existing rounded cartoon 3D look and about 15% cuboid/voxel accents. Keep the whole composition, camera, sunset office, route, elevator, all characters, original facial expressions, exact poses, teal chair, curved red fire extinguisher, bold comic effects, all Japanese HUD text, numbers, typography, buttons and screen framing unchanged and crisp.

Add deliberately handcrafted small CUBOID details to only a FEW secondary office props: the paper cartons and selected edges of a drawer cabinet get slightly stepped block-built geometry; the leaves of ONE peripheral potted plant become small clustered green cuboids. The surrounding desks and architecture keep the same smooth rounded toy forms. Introduce a modest handful of clearly three-dimensional tiny cube particles among the existing paper/powder/confetti effects. The dominant effect remains the original lively paper and soft white powder. This is a carefully balanced mix with small voxel accents, visibly readable close up, not a global replacement of the art direction.

Main character and coworkers retain their smooth rounded faces, curved hair locks, flexible smooth limbs, expressive eyes and mouths. The office chair cushion and extinguisher stay smooth and recognizable. Lighting remains soft warm cinematic toy lighting with original saturated reds, golden yellows and mint furniture. Sharp high-resolution 16:9 rendered 3D. Maintain the absurd slapstick energy and clarity of every original HUD element.
For this normal gameplay screen specifically: retain 「退勤タイム 00:12.84」, 「被害総額 ¥1,280,000」, 「3連鎖 ×3」, 「定時ラッシュ！」, 「残圧 72%」, 「出口まで18m」 and the arrow/SPACE control instructions. Put a few small white/orange cuboid particles at the outer rear edge of the extinguisher plume; the hero and path remain unobscured. A paper carton close to the left aisle, a drawer cabinet at right edge, and the right-side potted plant are the restrained voxel accents.
